newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi's Al-Baha region governor signs 80 million riyal deals to set up three industrial projects.
- Saudi Iron and Steel Co signs a 4.725 billion riyal loan agreement to finance a major expansion programme.
- Islamic Development Bank approves new loans worth $158.7 million to finance a number of development projects in member states.
- The private sector in Saudi Arabia has financed building of 400 schools at a cost of six billion riyals.
